scientific_integrity: Analytical infinite-family proof with exact transition formulas; symbolic and finite exact computations corroborate but do not replace proof; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Sharp positivity of completed RK4 on finite simple unit-weight clique bouquets only, not arbitrary universal-vertex graphs or intermediate RK stages. Historical originality is limited to the inspected sources; equivalent specialized work may exist.
title: Universal sharp RK4 positivity on heterogeneous clique bouquets
